name: Behalf.bot - Image generation
description: Generate images from a text prompt through one of two backends: a local ComfyUI running FLUX.1 (free, slow, private, nothing leaves the machine) or a hosted image API (fast, paid, better at text inside the image). One script, one CLI, a per-invocation flag to switch. Ships the ComfyUI workflow graph and a documented node-id contract so the graph can be swapped for a different one.

enabled.description: Master switch. Off by default: the local backend needs a ComfyUI install with several GB of model weights, and the hosted backend costs money per image.

default_backend.description: Backend used when the caller does not pass --comfyui or --openai. 'comfyui' is free and private but takes minutes; 'openai' takes seconds and bills per image. Consumed as IMAGEGEN_DEFAULT_BACKEND.

output_dir.description: Directory that receives generated PNGs, named generated-<timestamp>.png unless an explicit output path is passed. Consumed as IMAGEGEN_OUTPUT_DIR.

comfyui_url.description: Base URL of the ComfyUI HTTP API. Localhost is the normal case; point it at another host on the LAN if the GPU lives somewhere else. Consumed as COMFYUI_URL.

comfyui_output_dir.description: ComfyUI's own output directory, where it writes finished renders before this plugin copies them to output_dir. Must be readable by the chassis. Required when default_backend is 'comfyui' - there is no sensible default because it depends where ComfyUI was installed. Consumed as COMFYUI_OUTPUT_DIR.

comfyui_workflow_path.description: Path to the ComfyUI API-format workflow JSON. Defaults to the FLUX.1 graph shipped in this plugin. Swap it for your own graph, and set the node ids below to match.

comfyui_prompt_node.description: Node id in the workflow graph whose inputs.text receives the prompt. Matches the shipped FLUX.1 graph. Change it if you swap the workflow. Consumed as COMFYUI_PROMPT_NODE.

comfyui_seed_node.description: Node id whose inputs.noise_seed receives the random seed. Matches the shipped FLUX.1 graph. Consumed as COMFYUI_SEED_NODE.

comfyui_output_node.description: Node id of the SaveImage node whose output filename is read back from the history endpoint. Matches the shipped FLUX.1 graph. Consumed as COMFYUI_OUTPUT_NODE.

comfyui_timeout_seconds.description: How long to poll ComfyUI before giving up. FLUX.1 Q6_K on consumer hardware runs to roughly 11 minutes per image, so the default leaves headroom. Consumed as COMFYUI_TIMEOUT_SECONDS.

openai_model.description: Model id for the hosted backend. Consumed as IMAGEGEN_OPENAI_MODEL.

openai_size.description: Requested image dimensions for the hosted backend, e.g. '1024x1024', '1536x1024'. Consumed as IMAGEGEN_OPENAI_SIZE.

openai_quality.description: Quality tier for the hosted backend. Higher tiers cost more per image. Consumed as IMAGEGEN_OPENAI_QUALITY.

openai_base_url.description: API base for the hosted backend. Override to route through a compatible proxy or a self-hosted gateway. Consumed as IMAGEGEN_OPENAI_BASE_URL.

activation._note: On-demand only. Invoked when a task needs a generated visual. Dormant by default - the local backend needs model weights the chassis does not ship, and the hosted backend spends money on every call.

system.name: curl
system.install: apt-get install curl (Debian) / your platform's package manager

system.name: jq
system.install: apt-get install jq (Debian) / your platform's package manager
system._explanation: Injects the prompt and seed into the ComfyUI workflow graph and parses both backends' responses.

system.name: ComfyUI
system.install: https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI - plus FLUX.1 Dev GGUF, T5 XXL, CLIP-L and VAE weights in its models directory
system._explanation: Soft dependency, required only for the local backend. Roughly 20GB of weights and a GPU or Apple Silicon with equivalent unified memory. setup.sh reports its absence as a WARN, not a failure - the hosted backend still works without it.

system.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
system.install: set in the chassis secret store
system._explanation: Soft dependency, required only for the hosted backend. Never read from a file by this plugin - it comes from the process environment the chassis provides.
